gaps.lead: 'I will definitely complete the report by Friday,' I said.
gaps.explanation: commit oneself TO + -ing: committed myself to finishing.

gaps.lead: I'm sure Jemma is going to become a famous model one day.
gaps.sentence: I think it's only ___ Jemma becomes a famous model.
gaps.explanation: 'It's only a matter of time before' means it will definitely happen eventually.

gaps.lead: Nadia's friend arrived just as she was about to leave the restaurant.
gaps.sentence: Nadia was ___ the restaurant when her friend arrived.
gaps.hint: be about to = be on the point of + -ing
gaps.explanation: 'About to leave' becomes 'on the point of leaving'.

gaps.lead: The play was so boring that we left early.
gaps.explanation: 'So boring' becomes 'such a boring play that …'.

gaps.lead: Given that he has no experience, will Glyn be able to do this job?
gaps.sentence: Will Glyn's ___ his ability to do this job?
gaps.hint: no experience = lack of experience (noun subject)
gaps.explanation: The noun subject 'lack of experience' takes the verb 'affect'.

gaps.lead: She left early because she didn't want to miss the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive.
